tasks.title: Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path
tasks.description: src/brand.ts defines BRAND.socket = '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' (tested in test/brand.test.ts) but it is dead — never imported or read anywhere. The actual narration socket path is still the literal '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock', hardcoded independently in src/narration.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), src/commands/run.ts (narrationSocketPath), src/commands/narrate.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), lib/ralph_narrate_server.py (DEFAULT_SOCKET), and .claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh (SOCKET=). Unlike dataDir/configFile/tempPrefix, this identifier was never given the dual-name (current-preferred, legacy-fallback) treatment established in CLAUDE.md's 'Branding and the legacy layout' section, so it doesn't participate in the .cairn/.ralph rename at all. Decide whether to (a) apply the same current-preferred/legacy-fallback pattern to the socket path (probe both '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' and '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock' at connect/health-check time, like findDataDir does for directories), or (b) remove the unused BRAND.socket constant and its test if socket-path branding is intentionally out of scope. Note the hook shell scripts (.claude/hooks/*.sh) are per-project generated files (written by `ralph init`), so any fix needs to flow through whatever generates them, not just the TS/Python readers.
tasks.notes:
# Task #48 — Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path

## Decision: option (a), with one refinement

Applied the current-preferred/legacy-fallback pattern. Option (b) (delete
`BRAND.socket`) was never viable: `BRAND.socket` is already load-bearing in the
hook templates (`src/commands/init.ts`) and `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py`'s
`DEFAULT_SOCKET`, so removing it would mean reverting *those* to `ralph-tts` —
moving backwards.

**The refinement.** The task text suggested probing both `/tmp` paths "at
connect/health-check time, like `findDataDir` does". A pure `/tmp` existence
probe is wrong here, and would have *regressed* un-migrated projects:

- The socket's authoritative value is not in `/tmp`. It is baked into the
  project's `.claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh` as a `SOCKET="…"` line at
  `cairn init` time. Those hooks are the socket's **only** clients.
- At server-start time neither `/tmp` path exists yet (nothing is bound), so an
  existence probe always answers `BRAND.socket`. An un-migrated project whose
  hooks say `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` would then have the server bind
  `cairn-tts.sock` and every hook would go to a socket nobody listens on —
  silently. Today that project works (run.ts hardcodes `ralph-tts.sock`).

So resolution reads the hooks first, and falls back to the `/tmp` probe:

1. `<projectRoot>/.claude/hooks/narrate.sh` → whatever its `SOCKET="…"` says.
2. Else a live socket, `BRAND.socket` preferred over `LEGACY.socket`.
3. Else `BRAND.socket` (fresh server comes up under the current name).

## The live bug this fixes

Flagged by #46 and confirmed: `writeNarrationHooks` already emitted
`/tmp/cairn-tts.sock` while `run.ts` started the server on
`/tmp/ralph-tts.sock`. **Narration was a silent no-op on every freshly
`cairn init`-ed project.** Both sides now agree.

## Changes

**`src/brand.ts`**
- `BRAND.pidFile = '/tmp/cairn-tts.pid'` (new).
- `LEGACY.socket = '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock'`, `LEGACY.pidFile = '/tmp/ralph-tts.pid'` (new).
- Standing-rule doc comment extended to cover socket/pidFile.
- These are now the **only** `/tmp/ralph-tts.*` literals in shipped source.

**`src/narration.ts`**
- New `findNarrationSocketPath(projectRoot?, {exists?})` and
  `findNarrationPidFile({exists?})`, both exported. `PathProbeDeps` is the
  injection seam so tests can pin the `/tmp` probe.
- `HOOK_SOCKET_RE = /^\s*SOCKET="([^"]+)"/m` parses the hook.
- Two one-shot warnings via `warnLegacyOnce` (`narration-socket`,
  `narration-pidfile`).
- `startNarrationServer` / `stopNarrationServer` / `checkNarrationHealth`
  defaults now call `findNarrationSocketPath()` instead of a module constant.
- Removed the `TODO(#48)` block and `DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH`.

**`src/commands/run.ts`**
- `RunRunDeps.findNarrationSocketPath: (projectRoot: string) => string`, defaulted
  to the real one in the deps factory (~line 346). Injectable so run tests stay
  deterministic regardless of what is in the dev machine's `/tmp`.
- `narrationSocketPath = deps.findNarrationSocketPath(projectRoot)`.

**`src/commands/narrate.ts`**
- Removed `DEFAULT_PID_FILE` / `DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH`.
- `pidFile ?? findNarrationPidFile()`; `socketPath ?? findNarrationSocketPath(findProjectRoot())`.
- New import of `findProjectRoot` from `../utils`.

**No change needed:** `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` (already
`DEFAULT_SOCKET = "/tmp/cairn-tts.sock"` plus the
`CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET`/`RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` env chain, and `run.ts` always
passes `--socket` explicitly anyway) and the hook generators in
`src/commands/init.ts` (already interpolate `BRAND.socket`). The task's `files[]`
listed `lib/ralph_narrate_server.py`, which was renamed to
`lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` in an earlier task.

## Tests (TDD — written first, watched fail, then made to pass)

- **`test/narration.test.ts`** +12: full resolution matrix for both helpers
  (default, both-live, legacy-only-live, hook-wins-over-live-socket, hook with
  no SOCKET line, no hooks installed, warns-once, does-not-warn-on-current).
  Real temp dirs for the hook cases, injected `exists` for the `/tmp` probe.
  Also renamed two stale titles that claimed to assert `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock`
  but asserted nothing of the kind.
- **`test/brand.test.ts`** +4 assertions: `BRAND.pidFile`, `LEGACY.tempPrefix`,
  `LEGACY.socket`, `LEGACY.pidFile`.
- **`test/commands/run.test.ts`** +1: the resolver is called with `projectRoot`
  and its answer reaches both `startNarrationServer` and `stopNarrationServer`.
  Added `findNarrationSocketPath` to `makeRunDeps`.
- **`test/commands/narrate.test.ts`** +2: defaults resolve to current-brand
  paths; `narrate on` binds the socket the project's hooks dial.
- **`test/commands/init.test.ts` / `migrate.test.ts`** unchanged — they already
  asserted the hook templates emit `cairn-tts.sock`. Those assertions are now
  consistent with the server instead of contradicting it.

## `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` — the #48 exemption is gone

The `EXEMPT` list (its only entry was `/ralph-tts\.(sock|pid)/ → TODO(#48)`) was
deleted along with the branch that consulted it; the marker contract now has no
exemptions. Two new guards replace it:

- `/tmp/ralph-tts.{sock,pid}` may appear **only** in `src/brand.ts` — a second
  literal anywhere else means a path skipped the fallback.
- No source file may still contain `TODO(#48)`.

## Docs

- **CLAUDE.md**: new subsection *"The narration socket — a third naming tier"*
  under "Branding and the legacy layout" — the two helpers, why hooks outrank
  the `/tmp` probe, and why getting it wrong fails silently. Rewrote *"The
  removal marker"*'s exemption paragraph (no exemptions now; describes the two
  replacement guards).
- **README.md** §narration: replaced the "hasn't landed yet" paragraph.
- **docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md**: two `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` mentions → current path.

## Deliberately NOT changed

- **This repo's own `.claude/hooks/*.sh`** still say `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock`. That
  is now correct-by-resolution rather than a mismatch: verified
  `findNarrationSocketPath(repoRoot)` → `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` with the legacy
  warning, so this repo's narration keeps working untouched. They flip to
  `cairn-tts.sock` when this repo is finally migrated (`cairn migrate` rewrites
  hooks — `test/commands/migrate.test.ts:385`).
- `ralph.json` (this repo is still on the legacy layout — migrate manually once
  the round closes) and its pinned `healthCheck` outfile.

## Verification

- `bun test` → **862 pass, 0 fail**, 31 files (859+3 before this task's tests;
  net +19 from the new/changed tests, −0 removed).
- `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck` → clean, 0.44 MB.
- Live smoke test of both helpers against this repo root and against an empty
  root: legacy hooks → `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` + warning; no project →
  `/tmp/cairn-tts.sock`; pid → `/tmp/cairn-tts.pid`.
- The "FileNotFound opening root directory `src`" health-check error reported at
  iteration start is a cwd artifact of the pinned binary, not a source problem —
  the health-check command run from the repo root exits 0.

## Note for whoever closes the round

Per CLAUDE.md's pin/unpin procedure: re-run `./install.sh` and restore
`healthCheck` to its real outfile. Then migrate this repo itself
(`cairn migrate`), which will move `.ralph/` → `.cairn/`, `ralph.json` →
`cairn.json`, and repoint these hooks at `/tmp/cairn-tts.sock`.
